title: Concerning Ants and Queens
description:
Can talking about nature be hypnotic? You be the judge.

Can talking about nature be hypnotic? You be the judge.

Sometimes I forget that I’m supposed to do sexy things and get caught up learning new topics and areas of interest. Today, that’s entomology. Specifically, ants.

You see, ants have a very particular social order, and some incredibly unique means to ensure things stay structured as they should.

And I want to explore what we can learn from things like the slave maker ant, the ant queen, and more.

Art by Kayriko.
author: Mistress Calia
